### pltr api ontologies attachment upload

`pltr api ontologies attachment upload --body PATH --content-type TEXT --filename TEXT [OPTIONS]`

- `--body` PATH (required): Body of the request.

- `--filename` TEXT (required): The name of the file being uploaded.
- Options: `--content-length` INTEGER
